remarks:
Welcome to this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home on a quiet neighborhood street in the West Seneca School District. Offering a comfortable layout and plenty of potential, this property is ready for someone to add their personal touches and make it their own.

The main level features three bedrooms and one full bath. The mostly finished basement expands the living space and was previously used as two additional bedrooms and storage. It also includes a half bath, plus a battery back up sump pump  and could easily be adapted for use as a recreation room, home office, storage area, or additional living space.

Outside, the fully fenced-in yard provides a great setting for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying time with pets. The pool was closed for the season but was fully functional and enjoyed throughout the summer. 

Conveniently located near Southgate Plaza, shopping, restaurants, parks, and the Thruway, this home offers easy access to everyday amenities and commuting routes. With some TLC, it presents an excellent opportunity to create a home tailored to your vision.
